text: For the director of music. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.
on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on the Lord?
for God is present in the company of the righteous.
but the Lord is their refuge.
When the Lord restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
